report_topic: Implementation of 74th Constitutional Amendment Act in Chhattisgarh
observations_summary: The audit found that the State Government had not fully empowered Urban Local Bodies (ULBs) as per the 74th Constitutional Amendment Act, leading to delays in elections, non-constitution of various committees, and significant staff shortages. The financial position of ULBs was critical due to low own revenue, short devolution of funds, and unrealistic budget formulation, impacting service delivery despite some physical achievements in sanitation and solid waste management.
